Only groups 1 and 4 are ever written: measured on a held-out half (n=8,277) of the 16,554 grocery records that carry both an Open Food Facts NOVA value and an ingredient list, this method reaches 99.6% precision on group 1 and 99.7% on group 4. A medicine, a cosmetic and a concentrated ratio-extract are refused outright: NOVA classifies foods.
